cards.text: Moses is a long way from Egypt now. He's shepherding the flock of his father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian. He leads it to the far side of the wilderness, all the way to Horeb, the mountain of God.
And there, the angel of the LORD appears to him in a blazing fire from within a bush. Friend, Moses came out here for SHEEP, and nobody said anything about a show!

cards.question: Moses watches the bush blaze with fire. True or false: the fire burns the bush up.
A bush on fire that won't burn up. What does Moses decide to do?

answers.text: Go over and look at it up close
Lead the flock far away from it
Hurry back to tell Jethro about it

cards.text: When the LORD sees Moses has gone over to look, God calls out to him from within the bush: "Moses, Moses!" A bush on fire is one thing, friend, but a bush that knows your NAME?

cards.question: God has just called Moses by name from inside the bush. How does Moses answer?
God tells Moses not to come any closer and to take off his sandals. Why? The place where he's standing is ___ ground.

cards.text: Then God tells Moses who He is: "I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob."

cards.question: Moses now knows exactly who is speaking from the bush. True or false: he steps closer to get a better look.

cards.text: Moses hides his face, because he's afraid to look at God. Then the LORD tells him He has seen the affliction of His people in Egypt, heard them crying out, and He's aware of their sufferings.

cards.question: God has seen His people suffering in Egypt. What does He say He has come down to do?

answers.text: Teach them how to endure it

cards.text: He'll bring them up to a good and spacious land, flowing with milk and honey, the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites. Six nations in one breath, friend, so I had to count them on my mustache.
God says the cry of the Israelites has reached Him. He has seen how severely the Egyptians are oppressing them.

cards.question: Then God says, "Therefore, go!" He's sending Moses to ___ to bring His people out of Egypt.

cards.text: But Moses asks God, "Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh and bring the Israelites out of Egypt?" Friend, I get it, because when an angel came to my junk drawer, I asked him, "Are you sure you have the right drawer?"

cards.question: Moses wants to know who he is to go to Pharaoh. What does God tell him?

answers.text: I will surely be with you
You will surely find the strength
You were surely chosen from birth

cards.question: God gives Moses a sign that He's the one who sent him. Once the people are out of Egypt, they'll all worship God at ___.

cards.text: Then Moses asks what he should say if the Israelites ask him, 'What is His name?' This man is prepping for the Q and A before he's even said yes to the meeting!

cards.question: Moses asks what God's name is. What does God tell him?

cards.text: So Moses is to tell them, 'I AM has sent me to you.' God also tells him to say it's the LORD, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, who sent him.

cards.question: True or false: God says this name is only for the people of Moses' day.

cards.text: Then God lays out the plan. Moses is to assemble the elders of Israel and tell them the LORD has appeared to him and promised to bring them up out of their affliction in Egypt.

cards.question: True or false: God says the elders of Israel will listen to what Moses says.

cards.text: Then Moses and the elders are to go to the king of Egypt and tell him, "Now please let us take a three-day journey into the wilderness, so that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God."

cards.question: God already knows how the king of Egypt will take that request. What does He say?

answers.text: He won't let them go without a mighty hand
He'll let them go the first time he's asked
He'll let only the elders of Israel go

cards.text: So God will stretch out His hand and strike the Egyptians with all the wonders He will perform among them. I bet Pharaoh has NO idea what's coming.

cards.question: After all of God's wonders in Egypt, the king will ___ the Israelites.
God will give His people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so they won't leave empty-handed. What will they take with them?

answers.text: Silver and gold jewelry and clothing

cards.text: Every woman will ask her neighbor for it, and they'll put it on their sons and daughters. As God puts it, "So you will plunder the Egyptians."
Then Moses answers, "What if they do not believe me or listen to my voice? For they may say, 'The LORD has not appeared to you.'" So the LORD asks him, "What is that in your hand?"

cards.question: The LORD asks Moses what's in his hand. Moses answers that it's a ___.

cards.text: "Throw it on the ground," the LORD tells him. So Moses throws it down, and it becomes a snake.

cards.question: Moses' staff has just turned into a snake right there on the ground. What does Moses do?

cards.text: Then the LORD says, "Stretch out your hand and grab it by the tail." Friend, the man JUST ran from that thing, and now he's supposed to go GRAB it?

cards.question: Moses reaches out and catches the snake by the tail. True or false: it turns back into a staff in his hand.

cards.text: This is so the people may believe the LORD, the God of their fathers, has appeared to him. Then the LORD says, "Put your hand inside your cloak."

cards.question: Moses puts his hand inside his cloak and pulls it back out. What does his hand look like now?
The LORD has Moses put his hand back inside his cloak. True or false: it comes out still leprous.

cards.text: If they won't believe the first sign, they may believe the second. And if they don't believe even these two, Moses is to take some water from the Nile and pour it on the dry ground.

cards.question: The water Moses takes from the Nile and pours on the dry ground will become ___.

cards.text: Moses replies, "Please, Lord," and says he has never been eloquent, because he's slow of speech and tongue. Friend, that's anybody who's ever been handed the mic at a work party and forgot how words work.

cards.question: Moses says he's slow of speech. What does the LORD ask him?

answers.text: Who taught you how to speak
Why do you still doubt Me

cards.question: Then the LORD tells Moses, "Now go!" What does He promise him?

answers.text: To help him speak and teach him what to say
To make him the finest speaker in Egypt
To go and speak to Pharaoh Himself

cards.question: After all of that, Moses has one more request for the LORD. What is it?

answers.text: Please give me one more sign
Please let me wait a while

cards.question: The anger of the LORD burns against Moses. Then the LORD says Moses' brother ___ the Levite can speak well and is already on his way to meet him.

cards.text: When Aaron sees Moses, he'll be glad in his heart. Moses is to speak to him and put the words in his mouth.

cards.question: True or false: the LORD says He will help only Aaron to speak.

cards.text: Aaron will be Moses' spokesman to the people, and it will be as if Moses were God to him. A brother who's glad to see you AND does all the talking is the DREAM, friend.
But the LORD tells Moses to take this staff in his hand so he can perform signs with it. Friend, this story is just warming up, like my ovens at five in the morning.

findings.problem: Stop 3, card 5 quotes "Stretch out your hand and grab it by the tail.", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.
